archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Modified for Utility on Admin)
vibe: Customer: Warm, appetite-triggering, tactile, organic, cafe vibes. Admin: Dense, structured, highly legible, professional control room POS.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-heading tracking-tight leading-none text-foreground

descriptions.primary: Terracotta Red / Burnt Orange - triggers appetite, used for Place Order, Add to Cart
descriptions.background: Warm Sand - off-white with slight yellow/orange tint to feel like a physical cafe menu
descriptions.foreground: Deep Espresso - for text, avoids pure black, softer on eyes
descriptions.status_colors: Muted, professional colors for admin dashboard to track order states clearly

customer.strategy: Mobile-first bento grid. Generous spacing (p-4, p-6). Desktop should max-w-md or max-w-lg to mimic mobile web/kiosk app.
customer.menu_cards: Horizontal/Bento layout: Image left/top, text right/bottom. Generous padding inside cards.
customer.cart_drawer: Fixed bottom CTA on mobile, massive tap targets (h-14).
customer.header: Sticky top, glassmorphism, containing Logo and Loyalty points pill.

admin.strategy: Control Room Grid. Tight spacing (p-4, gap-4) prioritizing screen real-estate.
admin.dashboard_stats: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5. 1px borders, cardless look or very subtle shadow.
admin.orders_list: Dense table layout. Minimal padding inside cells for max data visibility.

surface_strategies.customer_cards: Neumorphism & Clay. Solid background (bg-card), soft shadow (shadow-sm), subtle border (border-border). Rounded-2xl.
surface_strategies.admin_panels: Grid Borders (Technical). Flat white bg, 1px border-border, no shadow. Sharp or rounded-sm.
surface_strategies.floating_cart: Glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80, 1px inner border, shadow-lg.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: -translate-y-1, shadow-md, transition-all duration-200 for food cards.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Pulse animations on image placeholders. Staggered fade-up for menu items.
motion_and_interaction.page_transition: framer-motion standard fade-in for customer switching categories.

component_instructions.buttons: Customer: Rounded-full, large tap targets (h-12). Admin: Rounded-md, dense, sharp (h-9 or h-10).
component_instructions.inputs: Shadcn UI overrides. bg-white, border-border, focus:ring-primary.
component_instructions.tabs: Customer menu categories: Pills (rounded-full) horizontally scrollable. Admin: standard underline tabs.
component_instructions.charts: Admin dashboard: Use Recharts, clean lines, no grid background, use primary brand color.
component_instructions.toast: Use Sonner for order status updates, placed bottom-center for customer, top-right for admin.

icons_strategy.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for admin (precision), stroke-width 2 for customer (friendly, bold).

testing_guidelines.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='place-order-button').
